description: Best sellers and rankings: 50 ranks per page, each with title, price, rating and image. If Amazon's second request fails, items after the first 30 have only rank, ASIN and URL.

category.description: Category slug as in Amazon's best-seller URLs, optionally with a node ID, e.g. electronics.

country.description: Amazon marketplace as an ISO country code. GB is amazon.co.uk. Default US.

name: get_best_sellers
